# Assessment Overview

Supplementary analysis for the Photo Album application:

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Application components, hosting boundaries, dependencies, and deployment considerations.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) — Declared libraries, version management, scopes, and compatibility considerations.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP endpoints, request and response contracts, security requirements, and communication sequences.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) — Persistence model, database storage, data lifecycle, and transaction boundaries.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Application settings, environment variables, profiles, and operational configuration.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) — Gallery browsing, photo upload, detail viewing, and deletion sequences.

See the [assessment report](../report.md) for cloud-readiness, Java-upgrade, and security findings.
